Hi Alex and Jordan,

Thanks again for your time on the call today — really helpful to hear about Acme’s goals for improving support QA with faster, auditable LLM inference. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Success criteria you called out: 1) match or exceed current semantic search recall on support KB, 2) <25% regression on answer accuracy for top-1 responses, 3) end-to-end latency under 400ms for a 512-token request in peak.
- Proposed evaluation: 2-week trial, isolated dataset (support KB), a set of ~500 prompt+reference pairs for evals, and a technical kickoff to align infra/ingest/security.

Ask: can we schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff next week to cover trial plan, roles, data handoff, and success metrics? Rishi (SE) and Dev (Infra) will join to cover the technical details and onboarding.

Proposed times:
- Wed 2026-07-01, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-07-01, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-07-02, 11:00–12:00 PT

If those don't work, please share two windows that do and we’ll send a calendar invite. I’m attaching a short kickoff plan and a sample prompt set to review ahead of the call.

Links:
- Calendly (pick a time): https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-demo-30m
